models.name: User Portrait
models.source_query: Which durable facts describe who the user is as a person: identity and context, aesthetic and design taste, communication preferences and hard language rules, values, boundaries, long-term goals? Keep only stable traits confirmed across sessions. Exclude project state, transient tasks, one-off requests, and coding or tooling preferences — those belong in user-preferences or working-memory.

models.name: Working Memory
models.source_query: What is the user currently working on across all projects: active projects and their state, decisions made with rationale, open threads, pending approvals, recent corrections, unfinished work? Include only what matters for continuing work in a new session. Exclude stable personal traits and preferences — those belong in user-portrait and user-preferences.
